sources.title: Models | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: The exact aion-labs/aion-2.0 entry calls Aion 2.0 a DeepSeek V3.2 variant intended for roleplay and storytelling and explicitly gives release date 2025-12-21. No parameter count or implementation architecture is supplied.

sources.title: Aion Labs public models API
sources.evidence: Exact ID entry: name AionLabs: Aion 2.0, date 2025-12-21, context_length 131072, max_completion_tokens 32768, reasoning true, tool_calls true, and architecture.modality text->text. No total or active parameter count; its architecture object describes modalities only.

sources.title: API Reference | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Defines per-model reasoning and tool_calls flags. Aion 2.0 supports reasoning_effort none, low, medium, high and max, with medium default. Explains that model created timestamps encode release dates.

sources.title: Aion Labs official Hugging Face organization
sources.evidence: Organization links aionlabs.ai and aionlabsai on GitHub. Its two public model repositories are Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B and its GGUF variant; no Aion 2.0 model card or weights are listed.

sources.title: Terms of Service of the Aion Labs API
sources.evidence: Current terms identify Aion Labs as a Deep Forge brand and limit rights in its served models to use through the service. They do not publish a downloadable Aion 2.0 weight license.

sources.title: AionLabs: Aion-2.0 | OpenRouter
sources.evidence: Confirms the hyphenated display name and DeepSeek V3.2 variant description, but displays February 23, 2026 as release date. This conflicts with Aion Labs explicit December 21, 2025 date; use developer evidence for original release.

sources.title: Models.dev Aion-2.0 record
sources.evidence: Baseline source uses the generic reasoning-workflow description and false open_weights flag. Its comment cites the Aion API date as the release-date source; not independent technical verification.

sources.title: aionlabsai GitHub profile
sources.evidence: Profile linked by official Hugging Face organization lists zero public repositories; no Aion 2.0 implementation or model configuration is available there.

name.note: Exact model ID confirmed. Developer display uses Aion 2.0; OpenRouter retains the catalog hyphenated spelling.

developer.note: Aion Labs publishes and serves this variant; underlying DeepSeek lineage should not be omitted from its family and description.

family.note: Explicitly described by the developer as a variant of DeepSeek V3.2.

release_date.note: Developer documentation and API agree. OpenRouter displays 2026-02-23; retain the original developer date rather than the conflicting provider date.

open_weights.note: Current official distribution is a hosted service; the official model organization exposes no Aion 2.0 download and the service terms grant only service-use rights. This does not claim an exhaustive search of every host.

license.note: No model-specific weight license published in inspected primary sources. API service terms are available, but the upstream model license must not be assigned to this variant automatically.

parameters_b.note: No exact total count disclosed for Aion 2.0; no released card/configuration. A DeepSeek V3.2 variant label does not establish unchanged parameter count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-parameter count disclosed for this exact variant. Do not transfer a base-model count.

architecture.note: DeepSeek V3.2 lineage is explicit, but exact network modifications and serving implementation are not. The API architecture object says only text->text; it is not evidence of dense or MoE architecture for this variant.

context_window.note: Exact API context_length; documentation rounds it to 128K.

reasoning.note: Explicit capability flag and documented reasoning controls for Aion 2.0.

tool_call.note: Explicit tool_calls true flag; reference defines it as accepting tools and returning tool calls.

description.value: Aion Labs variant of DeepSeek V3.2 optimized for roleplay and storytelling, with reasoning and tool calling.
description.note: Replace generic workflow copy with the documented lineage and intended specialization; avoid unmeasured comparative performance claims.

patch.description: Aion Labs variant of DeepSeek V3.2 optimized for roleplay and storytelling, with reasoning and tool calling.
patch.notes: Aion Labs identifies Aion 2.0 as a DeepSeek V3.2 variant, but does not disclose this variant's total parameters, active parameters or detailed architecture. Do not infer these from the base model. The developer gives 2025-12-21 as release date; OpenRouter displays 2026-02-23.

summary: Correct family to DeepSeek and replace generic description with the developer-confirmed DeepSeek V3.2 roleplay/storytelling variant identity. Confirm original release date, text modalities, 131072 context, reasoning and tool calls from primary sources. Public total/active counts and exact architecture remain undisclosed, so all three nulls stay. The developer calls this a variant; available evidence does not establish a mere resale/rebrand or the precise training/serving modifications. No Aion 2.0 weights or card in the official Hugging Face organization. Record conflicting OpenRouter date without changing the developer-backed baseline date.
